title: Is a Description Worth a Thousand Demonstrations? Specificity and Reliability of Task Descriptions in In-Context Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.25560v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A prompt for in-context learning (ICL) can describe a task in addition to, or instead of, demonstrating it through examples. Yet how task descriptions work remains poorly understood theoretically. Through the Bayesian view of ICL, we model descriptions as informative priors characterized by their specificity and reliability. We adapt the effective sample size (ESS) from Bayesian statistics, quantifying a description's predictive value as an equivalent number of demonstrations. For in-context linear regression, we show that a reliable description's ESS grows with its specificity and with the task's dimension. A description that may be irrelevant, however, gains little from its specificity unless demonstrations are given. In practice, do in-context learners use descriptions as a Bayes-optimal predictor would? Our experiments show that meta-trained Transformers come close to the Bayes-optimal ESS when tested on their training distribution.

translated_title: 一段描述值千条示例吗？上下文学习中任务描述的特异性与可靠性
translated_abstract: 用于上下文学习的提示词除了可以通过示例来演示任务，或者代替示例演示之外，还可以用文字来描述任务。然而，任务描述如何发挥作用在理论上仍缺乏充分的理解。本文通过上下文学习的贝叶斯视角，将任务描述建模为以特异性和可靠性为特征的信息先验。我们借鉴贝叶斯统计中的有效样本量（ESS）概念，将描述的预测价值量化为等效的示例数量。对于上下文线性回归，我们证明了可靠描述的ESS会随其特异性和任务维度的增加而增长。然而，可能不相关的描述除非同时给出示例，否则其特异性几乎不会带来收益。在实践中，上下文学习者是否会像贝叶斯最优预测器那样使用描述呢？我们的实验表明，元训练的Transformer在训练分布上进行测试时，其表现接近贝叶斯最优的ESS。
tldr: 本文从贝叶斯视角将上下文学习中的任务描述建模为信息先验，提出用有效样本量（ESS）来量化描述相对于示例的预测价值，证明了可靠描述的ESS随其特异性和任务维度增长，并通过实验表明元训练的Transformer在训练分布上接近贝叶斯最优的ESS水平。
en_tdlr: This paper models task descriptions in in-context learning as informative priors from a Bayesian perspective, quantifies their predictive value as an equivalent number of demonstrations via effective sample size (ESS), shows that a reliable description's ESS grows with its specificity and the task's dimension, and demonstrates that meta-trained Transformers approach Bayes-optimal ESS on their training distribution.
